name: Crown Point Energy, Inc.
summary: Crown Point Energy Inc., a junior international oil and gas company, engages in the exploration for, and development and production of petroleum and natural gas properties. It holds a portfolio of projects located in Argentina. The company was formerly known as Crown Point Ventures Ltd. and changed its name to Crown Point Energy Inc. in July 2012. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Calgary, Canada. Crown Point Energy Inc. is a subsidiary of Liminar Energia S.A.
